title: 23. How do I remove an existing survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I remove an existing survey.
short_answer: On the 'Surveys' page, open the survey you want and click on the 'Delete' icon. Once you have confirmed, your survey will be removed from the list of surveys.
procedure: Beware: deleting a survey removes every trace of your questions and your results from the EUSurvey system! This cannot be undone!
